output_units.normalized_text: morning: start in ribeira and walk the quay then take the 10 15 min uphill route to porto cathedral sé . keep it slow and photo-friendly expect about 2 500 3 000 steps.

output_units.normalized_text: afternoon: continue to são bento station then through the historic lanes toward rua das flores and miradouro da vitória. total walking: 45 60 min spread out about 3 000 3 500 steps.
output_units.text: Afternoon: Continue to São Bento Station, then through the historic lanes toward Rua das Flores and Miradouro da Vitória. Total walking: 45–60 min spread out, about 3,000–3,500 steps.

output_units.normalized_text: evening: cross toward the lower bridge area for sunset views then return to ribeira for dinner. keep the bridge-side loop to 30 40 min so the day stays under 9 000 steps.
output_units.text: Evening: Cross toward the lower bridge area for sunset views, then return to Ribeira for dinner. Keep the bridge-side loop to 30–40 min so the day stays under 9,000 steps.

source_units.normalized_text: - afternoon: continue to são bento station then through the historic lanes toward rua das flores and miradouro da vitória. total walking: 45 60 min spread out about 3 000 3 500 steps.
